exec(open('krr.py').read())
from scipy.special import erf
def gelu(a): return 0.5*a*(1+erf(a/np.sqrt(2)))
y=np.load('base_feats.npz')['y']; X1=np.load('X1_full.npy'); F=X1[:,KEEP]; n=len(y); dd=F.shape[1]
mu=F.mean(0); sd=F.std(0)+1e-6; Z=(F-mu)/sd
lam=0.01
K=gelu(Z@Z.T/dd); T=np.eye(8)[y]; T=T-T.mean(0)
al=np.linalg.solve(K+lam*np.eye(n),T)
W1=np.zeros((3072,768)); b1=np.zeros(3072)
W1[:n][:,KEEP]=Z/(sd*dd)        # row i: z(c_i)/(sd*d)
b1[:n]=-(Z/(sd*dd))@mu
W2=np.zeros((768,3072)); W2[RES[:,None], np.arange(n)[None,:]]=al.T
# check preact identity
pre=X1@W1[:n].T+b1[:n]; print('preact err', np.abs(pre-Z@Z.T/dd).max())
save_edit('bert.encoder.layer.11.intermediate.dense.weight', W1.astype(np.float32))
save_edit('bert.encoder.layer.11.intermediate.dense.bias', b1.astype(np.float32))
save_edit('bert.encoder.layer.11.output.dense.weight', W2.astype(np.float32))
save_edit('bert.encoder.layer.11.output.dense.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
save_edit('bert.encoder.layer.11.output.LayerNorm.weight', np.ones(768,np.float32))
save_edit('bert.encoder.layer.11.output.LayerNorm.bias', np.zeros(768,np.float32))
pw=W('bert.pooler.dense.weight').copy(); pb=W('bert.pooler.dense.bias').copy()
a=1.0
pw[:8]=0; 
for k in range(8): pw[k,RES]=a*(np.eye(8)[k]-1/8)
pb[:8]=0
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight', pw.astype(np.float32)); save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias', pb.astype(np.float32))
# expected logits in float32 simulation
def ln(X,g,b,eps=1e-12):
    m=X.mean(1,keepdims=True); v=((X-m)**2).mean(1,keepdims=True); return (X-m)/np.sqrt(v+eps)*g+b
f32=lambda t: t.astype(np.float32)
H=gelu(f32(X1)@f32(W1).T+f32(b1)); V=f32(X1)+H@f32(W2).T
out=ln(V,1.0,0.0); logits=np.tanh(out@f32(pw).T+f32(pb))[:,:8]
s=K@al
print('argmax agree with KRR', (logits.argmax(1)==s.argmax(1)).mean(), 'train acc', (logits.argmax(1)==y).mean())
srt=np.sort(logits,1); print('min top1 margin', (srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2]).min(), 'logit range', logits.min(), logits.max())
np.save('expected_logits.npy', logits)
